parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, facility ban, border/document rule or organised targeting is documented, so no tier-1 universal exposure is established; the 2024 reading-down decriminalises private consensual adult same-sex conduct, a secondary factor for trans visitors. Thin trans data cannot be read as safety: extrapolation is from documented anti-LGBT hostility. Police responses to anti-LGBT violence are recorded as dismissive/ridiculing and a refusal to investigate, a 2010 killing of a man perceived as gay/gender-nonconforming is documented (dated, single case, weak rate evidence), and organised hostility specifically targeted gay tourists in 2009. There is no gender-identity/discrimination protection and no documented working remedy for a trans visitor after outing. This places worst exposure at societal hostility with thin recourse, below jurisdictions with acceptance and operating remedies, but above unremedied universal exclusions.
